name: – Joachim Stanisław Brudziński – After § 5 – Am 3
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section IX – European Data Protection Supervisor
part_text: 5a. Expresses its concern about the significant increase in the final budget adopted for the EDPS, and deplores the fact that this increase, of 12,06 % between 2022 and 2023, well above the inflation rate, is the cause of budgetary waste such as the 54 % increase in the budget allocated to public communication and promotion activities;
